item.text: {"case_id":"SPR00333","decision":"candidate","candidate_ranking":["C06","C04","C09"],"selected_candidate_label":"C06","confidence":0.93,"relationship_type":"both","rationale":"C06, issued only one week earlier by the same President, supplies nearly the entire operative and recital structure of the child in the same wording and with the same stylistic choices, including “with respect to the dispute” rather than “said dispute” and “or by its employees.” The child plausibly adapted this immediately preceding template by substituting Northwest Airlines, its union, and two identified disputes. C04 and C09 are also strong because they concern the identical carrier-union pairing, but their older wording differs slightly and C04 contains an additional Defense Production Act provision omitted from the child.","shared_material":[{"child_excerpt":"WHEREAS these disputes have not heretofore been adjusted under the provisions of the Railway Labor Act, as amended; and WHEREAS these disputes, in the judgment of the National Mediation Board threaten substantially to interrupt inter state commerce to a degree such as to deprive a section of the country of essential transportation service","parent_excerpt":"WHEREAS this dispute has not heretofore been adjusted under the provisions of the Railway Labor Act, as amended; and WHEREAS this dispute, in the judgment of the National Mediation Board, threatens substantially to interrupt interstate commerce to a degree such as to deprive the country of essential transportation service","explanation":"The child reproduces the paired statutory and commerce-threat recitals, changing singular references to plural and narrowing the geographic formulation."},{"child_excerpt":"The board shall report its findings to the President with respect to these disputes within thirty days from the date of this order.","parent_excerpt":"The board shall report its findings to the President with respect to the dispute within thirty days from the date of this order.","explanation":"The reporting command is copied almost verbatim, with only the pluralization required for the two disputes."},{"child_excerpt":"As provided by section 10 of the Railway Labor Act, as amended, from this date and for thirty days after the board has made its report to the President, no change, except by agreement, shall be made by the Northwest Airlines, Inc., or by its employees, in the conditions out of which these disputes arose.","parent_excerpt":"As provided by section 10 of the Railway Labor Act, as amended, from this date and for thirty days after the board has made its report to the President, no change, except by agreement, shall be made by the Pan American World Airways, Inc., or by its employees, in the conditions out of which the dispute arose.","explanation":"This is the same detailed statutory standstill mechanism and sentence structure, adapted only to a different airline and plural disputes."}]}
